title: About me
paragraphs: If you are reading this, you must value your time. In short, I have started developing websites through WordPress, and when I was taught about blogging, I started my blogging journey. I used to run more than five websites and write content every day, but in the end, it was a failure. The reason is multitasking. With my learnings, I have mastered on-page SEO and did my first internship at a startup with my expertise in SEO and digital marketing skills. Along with this, I have started learning web development and started my first project with the MERN stack. After my graduation, I started preparing for the GATE exam for Masters in India, and I qualified for the exam. Meanwhile, I started my development journey back, and am learning backend development in-depth with Java, and am open to work.

When I'm not working, I enjoy playing chess, and watching movies. I also enjoy reading books. I am currently reading The Compound Effect by Darren Hardy and my favourite book is Eat That Frog by Brian Tracy.
